amended_rules.rule_title: Hugo Boss Permanent Brand Architecture (HUGO vs BOSS)
amended_rules.condition_trigger: Label identifies Hugo Boss / HB, or displays 'HUGO' or 'BOSS' typography.
amended_rules.rule_instruction: Classify into the permanent brand architecture: 'HUGO' (Gen Z / progressive streetwear / red logo / standalone retail stores) or 'BOSS' (contemporary luxury / tailoring / camel-black-white branding, including sub-lines BOSS Black, BOSS Orange, BOSS Green). This corporate restructuring is permanent, not a temporal line.
amended_rules.user_comment: Hugo Boss restructured into two distinct brand pillars: 'HUGO' and 'BOSS'. They have separate retail stores, differing design languages, and distinct target demographics. This is a permanent brand architecture, not a temporal line.

amended_rules.condition_trigger: Fabric weight specification is present in sample card or internal fabric documentation.
amended_rules.rule_instruction: Ensure extracted fabric weight in gm/m2 is strictly preserved in the GNW weight field even when visual inspection of main garment label lacks explicit density stamps.

amended_rules.condition_trigger: Garment collar visual features a distinct V-shape opening.
amended_rules.rule_instruction: Classify silhouette with explicit neckline attribute as 'V-Neck T-Shirt' or ensure '#v_neck' tag is retained to enable precise technical searching.

loops.evaluation_summary: Initial fresh extraction identified key silhouette and single jersey knit, with discrepancies in weight retention, buyer format, and neckline precision.
